notes.title: Big Performance Update and Windows Mixed Reality support
notes.content:
Mountain Mind is more stable, more intuitive and still the best headbanger and stoner rock experience out there (lol it's alone in that genre)

With Windows Mixed Reality support and HUUUGE performance changes you can bang your head to the mountain like you never did.

notes.title: Mountain Mind EP has been released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28018628/1817d2fc9b2beb99d4c2e9999e2bd3837e4b41d7.png[/img]Official soundtrack of Mountain Mind is now available as a DLC.

This EP is composed and recorded by Melih Küskü, with additions to mixing, editing and vocals from Dogan Çetin. 


Tracklist:

1. INTRO (02:14)
2. ASTEROID BLUES (03:49)
3. XARDOZ (03:45)
4. LIKE TEARS IN RAIN (03:41)
5. PALM DESERT '87 (02:39)
6. GODDESS OF TIME (06:29)
7. SUNSET OF VALLEY (01:01)
